description: List assets TorrentSwap can swap, with the id to use in get_quote, ticker, network and decimals. Any two different assets can be swapped. Optional query/network filters.

network.description: Optional filter by network id or name, e.g. "tron" or "solana".

query.description: Optional filter by ticker or name, e.g. "usdt" or "bitcoin".

name: list_assets
title: List swappable assets
